entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'm calling because I need to return a VeloBand Cadence Sensor I bought. I think I'm just outside the window, but there's a reason for it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference thing. It works fine, it's just not what I needed. I know it's been 26 days, but I did try to return it earlier.
Okay, I understand. Can you tell me what happened when you tried to process the return earlier?

Yes. It was on day 9, right before Christmas. I went on the website to start the return, but I kept getting a major website error. The whole return system seemed to be down, and I couldn't print the label or even get a confirmation number.
I'm sorry to hear you had that trouble, that must have been frustrating. Let me check our system logs for that date. One moment...
Okay, I see it. We did have a documented system-wide outage that day affecting the returns portal. That explains it perfectly. Thank you for your patience with that.
I'm glad you can see it on your end. I actually took a screenshot of the error page just in case. So, can we still process the return?

Absolutely. Let me just confirm the policy for your VeloBand... Okay, it looks like your product is covered by our standard 90-day return policy. Since you're only on day 26, you're well within the timeframe anyway. The system issue just added an unnecessary complication, and I apologize for that. I can process this return for you immediately.

That's great news, thank you, Charlie. I do appreciate that. Now, since I had to spend time dealing with the website issue and then calling in today, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase? I'm planning to buy a different VeloFit model, and that would definitely smooth things over.

That is a very reasonable request, especially considering the inconvenience our site outage caused. I see you're a VIP member with us, so let me see what I can do... Yes. I've just added a 25% off coupon to your account, valid for your next purchase. I've also just emailed you the return shipping label.
Wow, 25 percent is very generous. Thank you, Charlie. That's a perfect solution. I really appreciate your help today.
You are most welcome. We value your business. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's everything. You've solved it all. Thanks again.
My pleasure. Have a wonderful day and thank you for being a VeloFit customer.
